authorize.title: Sign in to Somtoday
authorize.description:
1. [Open the Somtoday sign-in page]({authorize_url}) in a new tab. Keep this setup open.

2. Before signing in, press F12. Open Network, enable Preserve log and select All.

3. Sign in. Find the last redirect: Headers → Response Headers → Location. Copy the entire value starting with `somtoday://`, including `code=` and `state=`. It may instead appear as a failed request or in Console. Do not copy the timetable URL or export a HAR.

4. Paste the full callback below. Do not share this temporary credential.

Text before the first underscore is removed and remaining underscores become spaces: PREFIX_Special_activity becomes Special activity. Otherwise the normal school-day title is used. Applies to the HA school-day calendar and school-day export, including when export is disabled.
data_description.day_excluded_names: One name per line, e.g. Flexlessen. Matches subject names and appointment titles, ignoring case. Applies only to school-day bounds and automatic day titles; individual lessons remain. Leave empty for no additional exclusions.
data_description.day_exclusion_match: Exact is safest. Contains excludes any appointment whose name contains the text. If all appointments are excluded, there is no school-day event.

data_description.lesson_prefix: Placeholder: {student_placeholder}. Added before each lesson title.
data_description.lesson_homework: Add homework to the HA timetable and lesson export. Only appointment assignments with exactly one matching start time and subject are included. Day/week assignments are not matched. Completion is shown only when known. No to-do list required.

holidays.name: Holidays
holidays.description: Somtoday dates uses the published first and final school-free date. Including surrounding weekends expands the event to the Saturday before and Sunday after. Daily creates one all-day event per published date. A continuous multi-week holiday also includes the weekends within its date range.

homework.name: Homework
homework.description: Choose a writable to-do list supporting creation, updates and descriptions. Permissions are confirmed during sync. Start with a dedicated Local to-do list. Disabling or changing the list keeps existing tasks.

data_description.homework_list: Dates are assigned only when explicitly known and supported by the list.
data_description.homework_bidirectional: Experimental: send completed/reopened changes from HA to Somtoday. Requires Somtoday write permission; parent accounts may be denied. Somtoday wins simultaneous changes. Unknown progress is not written back.
data_description.homework_include_appointment: Sync this type to the to-do list. When disabled, existing tasks remain and are no longer updated. Independent of homework in lesson descriptions.
data_description.homework_include_day: Sync this type to the to-do list. When disabled, existing tasks remain and are no longer updated. Independent of homework in lesson descriptions.
data_description.homework_include_week: Sync this type to the to-do list. When disabled, existing tasks remain and are no longer updated. Independent of homework in lesson descriptions.

absences.name: Absence overview
absences.description: Dates, categories and counts are always included. The school’s own wording is only added when you switch it on below.

data_description.absence_remarks: Adds the reason text written by the school, which can describe an incident in plain words. It becomes a sensor attribute, so Home Assistant also keeps it in its history database and backups, not only on dashboards that show it. Switching it off later stops new entries; what is already in the history stays until Home Assistant purges it.

live_activity.name: Live Activity / Live Update
live_activity.description: Enable the timetable card using this child’s switch. Starts 15 minutes before the first lesson; ends 10 minutes after the last. iPhone: Live Activity with the next classroom on the right and in the Dynamic Island. Android: Live Update with the next classroom in the notification and, on Android 16+, the status bar. Older Android versions show an ongoing timetable notification. Home Assistant must be reachable at school.
